## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: Contract test asserts conflict_resolver never proposes (write, dso-id) mutation — inspects output across 6-case test matrix from draft-9

Create tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_no_dso_id_writes.py with parametrized test driving conflict_resolver through 6-case provenance matrix from draft-9. For each case inspect every resolved Mutation and assert none has target=='label' AND payload.startswith('dso-id-') AND action in {'create','update'}. dso-id label remains exclusively under inbound_clean_label/outbound_create jurisdiction; conflict_resolver per-element provenance MUST skip it. Parametrized ids match draft-9 case names.

## Test Approach
Given 6-case provenance matrix from draft-9 supplied as parametrized fixtures; When conflict_resolver processes each case and returns resolved Mutations; Then for every case no resolved Mutation has target='label' with payload starting 'dso-id-' and action in {create, update}.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint: ruff check tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_no_dso_id_writes.py
- [ ] Parametrization collects all 6 draft-9 cases
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_no_dso_id_writes.py --collect-only -q
- [ ] All 6 cases assert zero dso-id label create/update mutations
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_no_dso_id_writes.py

## File Impact
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_no_dso_id_writes.py — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
